name: Latter Deposed Emperor of Liu Song
wp: Latter Deposed Emperor of Liu Song
wd_description: Liu Song emperor of the Liu Song dynasty
extract:
The Latter Deposed Emperor of Liu Song (Chinese: (劉)宋後廢帝, also known as Houfeidi; 1 March 463), – 1 August 477 also known by his posthumously demoted title of Prince of Cangwu (蒼梧王), personal name Liu Yu (劉昱), courtesy name Derong (德融), childhood name Huizhen (慧震), was an emperor of the Liu Song dynasty of China.
During his brief reign as a boy emperor, he showed a knack for violence and arbitrariness, and in 477 he was killed by his general Xiao Daocheng, who made Houfeidi's brother Liu Zhun emperor but seized the throne in 479, ending Liu Song and starting Southern Qi.
